title: Causal Inference with Unobserved Confounding: A Mixture Learning Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2609.23219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unobserved confounding is a fundamental challenge in causal inference from observational data. This article develops a mixture-learning perspective, viewing latent confounders as sources of heterogeneity that induce mixture structure in observed data. Under suitable structural and identifiability assumptions, recovering the mixing distribution and component mechanisms enables estimation of interventional distributions and causal estimands. Using variants of Bernoulli mixtures as a running example, we contextualize mixture-learning techniques and their structural assumptions, and connect them to causal inference in panel-data settings, including latent factor models and synthetic interventions.We then consider high-dimensional exponential-family mixtures with dependent outcome trajectories, moving beyond counterfactual means to model counterfactual distributions. translated_title: 具有未观测混杂因素的因果推断：一种混合学习视角
translated_abstract: 未观测混杂因素是从观测数据进行因果推断中的一个根本性挑战。本文发展了一种混合学习视角，将潜在混杂因素视为异质性的来源，这种异质性会在观测数据中诱导出混合结构。在适当的结构性和可识别性假设下，恢复混合分布及各成分机制能够实现对干预分布和因果估计量的估计。以伯努利混合的多种变体作为贯穿全文的示例，我们将混合学习技术及其结构假设置于具体情境中，并将其与面板数据设置中的因果推断联系起来，包括潜在因子模型和合成干预。随后，我们考虑了具有相依结果轨迹的高维指数族混合模型，超越反事实均值，对反事实分布进行建模。我们将这一视角与处理未观测混杂的其他互补方法进行了比较定位。
tldr: 本文提出用混合学习的视角处理因果推断中的未观测混杂问题，将潜在混杂视为数据异质性的来源，通过恢复混合分布与成分机制来估计干预分布和因果估计量，并将该框架与面板数据中的潜在因子模型和合成干预方法相联系，进一步拓展到对反事实分布（而非仅均值）的建模。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a mixture-learning perspective for causal inference with unobserved confounding, treating latent confounders as sources of heterogeneity that induce mixture structure, showing that recovering the mixing distribution and component mechanisms enables estimation of interventional distributions, and connecting this framework to latent factor models and synthetic interventions in panel-data settings, extending beyond counterfactual means to full counterfactual distributions.
